about: Pictures captured on the macOS test machine for the README: platform, feature, captions and how each was made. "agent": "simulated" marks a picture whose agent sessions are small local programs speaking Claude Code's stream format (scripts/e2e/demo_agents.py), never a real agent or a model call; their model shows as "simulated".
